name: Ikari Satoru
source:
33 years old.

Works at a talent agency as [url=https://vndb.org/c102382]Jack[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c106446]Azamin[/url]'s manager. He’s always on the hunt for new talent, and reaches out to anyone he feels has potential, regardless of whether they're human or a model prisoner from Hell.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/tengoku/characters/satoru/]Aksys Games[/url]]
